Icon present and pixel-equivalent on the delivered page (footer crop-compare 99.95%/99.82%, chrome-parity within tolerance; every footer icon img 42x42 loaded on the preview). The probe pairs icons by anchor + file name: the source anchors the text-less social links by href and the logo by an unnamed button, the build anchors them by their accessible name (aria-label = the source img alt, header commit 49efe8d) and EDS renames every image to media_<hash>; the fixed z-index:-2 footer is covered by the page at signature time, so the pixel-signature pairing cannot rescue them. Look-neutral; decided hands-off by the C-archetype agent (2026-11-12), owner may revisit.
